name: Campingplatz Ammertal
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Ammertal Camping Ground is located in the village of Peißenberg in the Austrian state of **Tirol**. The site is situated in the valley of the Ammer River, surrounded by meadows and forests, creating a tranquil and natural atmosphere perfect for guests seeking relaxation. The **Ammergebirge** mountains offer several well-marked **hiking trails** for varying difficulty levels. In winter, nearby ski resorts like the **Zugspitzarena** are just a short drive away. The facilities include sanitary amenities with showers and toilets, parking spots for RVs and tents, plus electrical hookups and waste disposal stations. Guests can use the site as a base for day trips into the region’s stunning mountain landscapes.
